name: ARK: Survival Ascended Dedicated Server
description: Install the ARK: Survival Ascended dedicated server through SteamCMD and launch its native Windows server binary directly without a shell.
known_limitations: The current Steam dedicated-server manifest advertises a Windows server only; GameNode does not pretend that a Proton/Wine wrapper is a native Linux launch.
GameNode manages selected ServerSettings values through a bounded sectioned INI adapter. Advanced gameplay, mod, cluster, BattlEye, and other INI settings remain unmanaged.
GameNode uses bounded native termination and does not claim guaranteed graceful save behavior. Automatic updates, mod installation, and update-on-start are outside this template.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Map identifier passed to the dedicated server. The default is TheIsland_WP.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: Name shown in the ASA server browser.

variables.name: Game port
variables.description: UDP port for ASA game traffic.

variables.name: Query port
variables.description: UDP query port used by the server browser.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Optional password for ASA administrator commands.

variables.name: PvE mode
variables.description: Disable PvP and run the server in PvE mode.

variables.name: RCON port
variables.description: TCP port used by ASA RCON when enabled.

requirements.description: The current reviewed Steam dedicated-server manifest advertises Windows.
Managed anonymous SteamCMD installation is required.
The ASA dedicated server requires an x86-64 host.
Ensure sufficient storage for the current ASA server build, saves, and optional mods.

help.summary: GameNode installs SteamCMD App ID 2430930 and launches ArkAscendedServer.exe directly.
notes: Forward the registered UDP game and query ports.
Advanced settings belong in the generated WindowsServer INI files; GameNode does not rewrite them.
The map variable uses ASA's _WP map identifier.

findings.summary: The current Steam dedicated-server configuration advertises Windows only; Linux Proton/Wine is intentionally not treated as a native supported platform.
Advanced ASA settings, passwords, mods, cluster configuration, and BattlEye are documented but not managed by a compiled GameNode adapter.
GameNode uses bounded native termination and does not claim that ASA will always save before termination.

prerequisites: Network access to Steam content servers during installation
Sufficient storage for server files and world saves
